notes.title: Small typo fixes and translation update
notes.content:
Fixed a few typos and added Episode 5 translations for the following languages:

- Japanese
- Portuguese Brazilian
- Thai
- Turkish

Currently only Romanian and Russian remain, the translators are still hard at work. And when these are finished they will be patched in as well.

notes.title: Episode 4 - now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, here it finally is!

Episode 4 is the largest and most ambitious episode to date. I really hope you will all enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227965/fddfc3e83357ca884c572ac650e1de8b108f1ccd.png[/img]

[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] 2300+ new renders
[*] 108 new animations
[*] 61 new songs
[*] 13 new achievements
[*] Small tweaks/improvements to existing renders and writing
[*] It is now possible to change Jane's last name, if desired. This will require a new playthrough though.
[*] Added translations (for episodes 1-3) for Japanese, Korean, Romanian and Turkish.
[*] Other quality of life improvements
[/list]
[b]Translation status[/b]
Please note that episode 4 is not yet translated for all languages. Currently, Brazilian Portuguese, French, German, Italian and Spanish are up to date. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227965/7608940498d12eb12bc43030d286381b56188aa6.png[/img]
Translators are working hard on getting the rest of the languages translated as well. They will be patched in once translations are done. Please understand that there is a lot of new text in this update, so it may take some time.

Ps. If you don't see the update automatically, it may help to restart Steam.

Enjoy!



~ Quadruple-Q
